6 تواهبوا They gave gifts, one to another. (S, K.) ―
-b2- فِيهِمِ التَّوَاهُبُ [They have a habit of mutually giving gifts]. (TA.) ―
-b3- تَوَاهَبَهُ النَّاسُ بَيْنَهُمْ [The people gave it; one to another]. (TA.) ―
-b4- وَلَا التَّوَاهُبُ فِيمَا بَيْنَهُمْ صعةٌ [Nor is their mutual giving of what is (possessed) among them (from fear of) humiliation]: i. e., they do not give by constraint. (TA, from a trad.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
